description: Aeropuerto Internacional de Tocumen - Destinos comerciales registrados en el mes de de is a series of datasets listed in Panamanian national open data portal (datosabiertos.gob.pa), an open data portal, published or maintained by Tocumen Aeropuerto Internacional de Panamá. Destinos comerciales con conexión directa hacia y desde el Aeropuerto Internacional de Tocumen mensualmente durante el mes de enero del 2025. Coverage: Panamá. The portal lists 19 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Tocumen Aeropuerto Internacional de Panamá. Its tags are aeropuerto, aviación, conexiones, destinos, destinos enero 2025. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, XLS. The portal shows 2025-03-18 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-pa-portal.
